title: Do Not like the taste from this, but hubby does.
text:
Do Not like the taste from this, but hubby does.. Easy to use, does not drip or leak.

That said I hate the taste Of The water from this. I will not drink it
The water taste thick, if that makes sense! And has a odd taste.
My husband likes this, but he never complains.

Having a new reverse osmosis system installed.

description: Drink cleaner*, great tasting tap water with this Brita 27 cup UltraMax water dispenser. The 9-cup reservoir and the 18-cup body add up to an extra large capacity that makes this water filtration system perfect for busy families, sports teams and offices, while the space efficient design allows for convenient storage. Made without BPA, and includes one Brita Standard Filter. The Standard Filter reduces chlorine (taste & odor), mercury, copper, and more** to deliver great tasting water. Designed to leave no black flecks in your water and with no pre-soak required, the Brita filters are quick and easy to use. Change your Brita Standard Filters every 40 gallons or approximately 2 months, based on average family usage of 11 glasses per day, for best performance.Plus, just a glance at the filter indicator lets you know when it is time to change the Brita water filter. The fridge-friendly size is perfect for busy families, sports teams and offices. Enjoy great tasting water without the single use plastic bottle waste! Package May Vary * vs. tap water. **See certifications.
